description: This file defines the NextWordDictionary class, which manages next-word suggestions for a keyboard application. It handles storing, loading, and providing suggestions based on previous words, utilizing internal data structures and storage mechanisms.

classes.name: NextWordDictionary
classes.description: Main class managing next-word suggestions, storage, and retrieval logic.

classes.name: SimpleIterable
classes.description: Inner class providing iterable over a fixed array of strings for suggestions.

methods.name: NextWordDictionary
methods.description: Constructor initializing storage and iterable for suggestions.

methods.name: notifyNextTypedWord
methods.description: Records the usage of a word following the previous word to update suggestion data.

methods.name: getNextWords
methods.description: Returns an iterable of suggested next words based on current word, with constraints.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Stores current suggestion data to persistent storage.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads stored suggestion data into memory.

methods.name: resetSentence
methods.description: Resets the internal state for sentence context.

methods.name: dumpDictionaryStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistics about the stored suggestion data.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears all suggestion data and resets state.
